method: Manual projected skeletal centre lines on actual quantized atlas, everyframe viewed at3x. H visible hair crown-chin axial distance inclusive1. T collar-hem; A UA+FA; L thigh+shin; S visible heel-to-toe plantar axis; sole-facing values cannot certify shoe length. Endpoint±2 propagated to T±4, chains±6; additional uncertainty as noted. Old neutral head requirement and combat anatomical denominator explicit. No colour or garment-area pass. No complete ±6% pass for any frame.
